title: Bishop Nathanyel | Revelation 8 A Star Called Wormwood

sense.text:
Today's class is entitled A Star Called Wormwood, and it continues the understanding of the book of Revelation, due to the latest events occurring between Iran and the United States of America, the impeachment of Donald Trump, and so forth. Things are at work in the spirit and we need desperately to prepare ourselves. Like Christ said in Matthew 24 regarding the last days, there shall be wars and rumours of wars; rumours are things in the talk, in the ear, in the air, that have not occurred as yet but may and will come to pass.

“Have mercy upon us, O Lord God of all, and behold us:” This is what we want: we want mercy. Like it says in Isaiah 14, the Lord will have mercy on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel. It says yet because we messed up; mentally and spiritually we are still messed up as a whole, as a people.

“And send thy fear upon all the nations that seek not after thee. Lift up thy hand against the strange nations, and let them see thy power.” Sirach is asking the Lord to lift up his hand against the strange nations; these are the non-Israelite nations.

“As thou wast sanctified in us before them: so be thou magnified among them before us.” Because he is going to smite these down, every last one of them, like it says in Daniel 7:9. “And let them know thee, as we have known thee, that there is no God but only thou, O God.” The whole world is going to know that there is only one God, that's it, and we are going to make all nations bow the knee.

“Shew new signs, and make other strange wonders: glorify thy hand and thy right arm, that they may set forth thy wondrous works.” You see all the fires in Australia, things happening all across the earth: a billion animals got burnt up in Australia. What is happening on the earth? What is going on? “Raise up indignation, and pour out wrath:” That is what we are seeing happen, but because we have spiritual blindness on we don't correlate what we see on the news to the Bible prophecies. “take away the adversary, and destroy the enemy.”

Make the time short: that is what we want right there. We often ask how long we are going to be in this captivity; Sirach said in the spirit, make the time short. Christ said the same thing in Matthew 24:22: except those days should be shortened, there should no flesh be saved, but for the elect's sake, Israel, those days shall be shortened. And Paul said the time is short: they that have wives, be as though they had none, meaning put God first (1 Corinthians 7:29). Which would you rather have when the Lord returns: you out doing the work, or you huddled under your woman's skirt?

Some of us know and believe the end is coming; some of us are just hoping the end is coming; and some are just here in unbelief, abiding for a job or a spouse, whichever comes first, and then we will never see you again, and God won't see you any more either. Christ cut them sharp in John 6:26: ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled. Some of us listening, in here or online, are only following because there is some benefit you are looking for, food, a job or a spouse. Some people will only love you as much as they can use you; their loyalty ends where the benefits stop. Paul said for yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry; the just shall live by faith, but if any man draw back, my soul shall have no pleasure in him (Hebrews 10:37-39). You leave this truth, you have drawn back unto perdition, hell.

“remember the covenant, and let them declare thy wonderful works.” That is what we are doing: we are declaring the covenants and the wonderful works of the Most High God.

precepts.why: Make the time short. Christ said the same thing: “And except those days should be shortened,” He is going to shorten the time. “there should no flesh be saved:” Because if you don't shorten the time, everybody would die, all of Israel; that is what he is talking about. “but for the elect’s sake” That is the proof that it is Israel: we are the elect. “those days shall be shortened.” The days shall be shortened.

“But this I say, brethren, the time is short:” You were wondering why we went here, ain't that talking about women? The time is short, brothers. “it remaineth, that both they that have wives” That's you married men. “be as though they had none;” Meaning what? Put God first. That is all it is saying. It doesn't mean drop your wife like a bad habit; it means put God first, and that is something black men have a hard time doing, with all them damn Keith Sweat songs. Millennials, who is the latest crying Negro out there crying for women? All this crying for women has to stop; the Most High is going to make this thing stop. You brothers are going to stop running around kissing a woman's behind. That is what Paul is saying. Which would you rather have when the Lord returns: you out doing the work, or you huddled under your woman's skirt, oh baby, I love you? Here comes the Lord and you ain't doing his work, you are doing her work. What is my servant doing?

Some of us know and believe the end is coming. Some of us are just hoping the end is coming. And some are just here in unbelief abiding: abiding time for a job, or a spouse, whichever comes first, and then we will never see you again, and God won't see you any more either. The ones that are only here for a spouse are the ones that can't wait for the proving process, six months to a year; they do the back-door marriage. Oh, that IUIC camp has some pretty women in there; oh, they have some handsome dudes in there; then bang bang, and they are out in the world again. Some of them used to sit right here; now they went to another camp and got another man, measuring tape and all.

“When the people therefore saw that Jesus was not there, neither his disciples, they also took shipping, and came to Capernaum, seeking for Jesus. And when they had found him on the other side of the sea, they said unto him, Rabbi,” Rabbi means master. “when camest thou hither? Jesus answered them and said, Verily, verily, I say unto you,” Listen good to what Christ says to these people that were looking so desperately for him, like they believed. “Ye seek me, not because ye saw the miracles, but because ye did eat of the loaves, and were filled.” Christ cut them sharp: some of you only seek me not because of the miracles but because you got food; you got fed, and that is why you follow me. Believe it or not, some of us listening right now, in here or online, are only following because there is some benefit you are looking for, whether it be food, a job or a spouse. One of those three things.

“Labour not for the meat which perisheth,” Labour means to work; don't work and strive for the meat that perishes. “but for that meat which endureth unto everlasting life,” The meat that endures unto everlasting life is the word of God, the commandments. “which the Son of man shall give unto you: for him hath God the Father sealed.” Some people, men and women, will only love you as much as they can use you; their loyalty ends where the benefits stop. There has been a slew of people who say the Quest was good, I'm going on the Quest, and they spend their rent money, and when they come back from the Quest, can you give me my rent money, I need help. That means you should not have gone on the Quest, because you were not prepared to go. Or they ask for the rent money before, and then go on the Quest after. It is like a pattern we see, and don't think we are simple, we see it, and the Lord sees that too.

Some people are only here for what benefit they can suck out of this truth, and it is never a righteous thing they are looking for. “For yet a little while, and he that shall come will come, and will not tarry.” Paul is reminding the Israelites, the Hebrews: he will not wait long. “Now the just shall live by faith:” You brothers and sisters, the just, those of you that are in here sincerely in this truth, live by faith. “but if any man draw back,” If any of you draw back, you decide, you know what, I'm going back out into the world, or I'm going to separate and do my own thing and curse the brothers and sisters that taught me: that is drawing back; you are not in the truth. “my soul shall have no pleasure in him.” You ever notice the spirits that draw back all of a sudden get revelations of great wisdom? I drew back from you all, I don't believe what you all believe, but God has now endowed me with wisdom: this is when the days begin, this is when the Sabbath begins. It is a pattern; it is the same thing from decades past, so it is no shock any more. It is like the same demon that jumps on people and says, now you have the wisdom, go ahead and do your thing: the days are wrong, and I have the wisdom and you don't. It is the same spirit. And they all say they are not drawing back, they are still in the truth, with all the evil. The scripture says if you have hatred in your heart for your brother you are a murderer, and no murderer has eternal life abiding in him. So you call the police on a brother, get him locked up unlawfully, get his furniture taken, his kids sleeping on the floor, even try to get his kids thrown out, then get on YouTube and Facebook and say I'm still in the truth? What scripture allows that? The god they are following is called Beelzebub, Satan, Lord of the Flies. But they are still in the truth.

“But we are not of them who draw back unto perdition;” We are not of them who draw back unto hell; that is what perdition means, hell. You leave this truth, you have drawn back unto hell. “but of them that believe to the saving of the soul.” That is what we are: we believe unto the saving of the soul.

sense.text: This is John the Revelator on the island of Patmos, written around 96 AD; Patmos was a salt mine, a prison camp where Rome put some Israelites. “And I saw in the right hand of him that sat on the throne a book written within and on the backside, sealed with seven seals.” So there was a book that the Lord, the Father, held in his hand. As you read down it tells you that no man was worthy to break the seals off the book to bring forth judgment and wisdom, but then the Lamb came, which was Christ, and he began to break the seals off this particular book, and this particular book brought forth judgment upon the earth and understanding upon the earth.

“And when he had opened the seventh seal,” The seventh seal was one of the seals that was on the book that was in the Father's hand. “there was silence in heaven about the space of half an hour.” Write this down in your notes: at the opening of the seventh seal, the elect of Israel are already caught up and in the wilderness. By the time this seal is opened the elect have already been taken up and are in the wilderness; the series is going backwards, so that comes another time.

“And I saw the seven angels which stood before God; and to them were given seven trumpets.” When this seventh seal was opened there were seven angels that came forth, and these seven angels had seven trumpets.

“And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer;” A censer is like the brass one carried around here (ours is brass because we're poor); they put incense in there and light it, and it puts out the smell of frankincense and myrrh. This is the same thing that is happening here; it occurred in the book of Exodus too. “and there was given unto him much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.” Notice it says the prayers of all saints. The saints are the children of Israel (Psalms 148:14); there are no Edomite saints, no Jebusite saints, no Moabite or Philistine saints. And this angel has a name: I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints (Tobit 12:15). So this is Raphael. “And the smoke of the incense, which came with the prayers of the saints, ascended up before God out of the angel’s hand.” All the prayers we are making to the Father are going up, and Raphael makes sure it goes before the Lord.

“And the angel took the censer, and filled it with fire of the altar, and cast it into the earth:” What did he do? He took the censer and filled it with fire, and what was in it? The prayers of the saints, and he threw the prayers down to the earth. “and there were voices, and thunderings, and lightnings, and an earthquake.” That is going into our prayers being answered immediately. Sometimes you pray and it seems like the Lord doesn't answer, like he ain't listening, but there is going to come a day: before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear (Isaiah 65:24). That day is when Raphael takes the prayers of the saints and casts them to the earth; our prayer is going to be answered immediately, in the midst of speaking. And we are not in Babylon when this happens: the Lord will bring us out from the people, gather us out of the countries, and bring us into the wilderness of the people, and there plead with us face to face (Ezekiel 20:33-35). Christ is going to be in our midst, walking amongst us, and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced, and mourn for him as one mourneth for his only son (Zechariah 12:10): when we see him we are going to cry bitterly on that day, all of us.

Why will our prayers be answered immediately? John gave the key: whatsoever we ask, we receive of him, because we keep his commandments (1 John 3:22). That is the stipulation of God answering prayers. Christians say God answers my prayers and I ain't keeping a damn commandment; Satan answers prayers too: all these things will I give thee, if thou wilt fall down and worship me (Matthew 4:8-9). Hollywood and the entertainment world have bowed the knee to Satan; that is your mama in the church getting so-called blessings from that white man on the wall. The outer laws, your hair, your beard, your clothing, are easy; the internal moral laws take more time, and all of them stem from thou shalt not covet. We are still struggling to get to the level where Christ was, keeping the commandments and having his prayers answered immediately. And we must do those things that are pleasing in his sight: go out and teach the word, the older women teaching the younger women; there is more to it than sitting in your room keeping the commandments. If we ask any thing according to his will, he heareth us (1 John 5:14), and to know his will you must study the Bible: thy law is within my heart (Psalms 40:8). Christ makes intercession for the saints according to the will of God (Romans 8:27). And ye ask, and receive not, because ye ask amiss (James 4:3): you pray for the wrong reasons, to consume it upon your lusts. That is how we get our prayers answered, slowly but surely.
“And the seven angels which had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.” So these seven angels which appeared in the seventh seal prepared to sound the trumpets.

precepts.why: This proves who the saints are, in case some of you are new and you read that word saints and that Christian song pops in your head, When the Saints Go Marching In, and you think everybody that believes in Jesus is a saint. “He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel,” The word even means indeed: indeed of the children of Israel. The children of Israel are the only saints in the Bible. There are no Edomite saints, no Jebusite saints, no Moabite or Philistine saints; they don't exist.

Tobit is in the Apocrypha, the book the white man says is not canon, you're not supposed to read that. Ah, shut the hell up; you don't tell us what to read. They took that out first from the slaves: some of these slaves know how to read, get rid of that, especially in the Caribbean islands, because they were using the book of Maccabees as fuel for insurrection to fight against the slave masters. “I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.” So now we know the name of the one of these seven angels who deals with the prayers of Israel, that deals with the incense. Now you can put a name to this angel in Revelation 8:3: this is Raphael. All the prayers we make to the Father go up, and Raphael makes sure they go before the Lord.

The angel cast the prayers of the saints into the earth, and there were voices, thunderings, lightnings and an earthquake: that is going into our prayers being answered immediately. Sometimes you pray and it seems like the Lord doesn't answer; it is like he ain't listening. But there is going to come a day, and Isaiah prophesies this thing right here. “And it shall come to pass, that before they call, I will answer; and while they are yet speaking, I will hear.” That right there is evidence: that day, when Raphael takes the prayers of the saints and casts them to the earth, our prayer is going to be answered immediately. We are in the midst of speaking and the Lord is going to say, I'm answering that already. Can't you wait for that day?

When this happens we are not in Babylon; we are someplace outside of Babylon when the Lord answers our prayers while we are yet speaking. “As I live, saith the Lord God, surely with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out, will I rule over you: And I will bring you out from the people,” We are going to be taken out from the people, out from Babylon. “and will gather you out of the countries wherein ye are scattered,” Wherever our people are scattered that believe, that are waiting for salvation, he is going to gather them up too. “with a mighty hand, and with a stretched out arm, and with fury poured out.” Because he ain't going to play with none of us.

“And I will bring you into the wilderness of the people,” That is why, when the Lord is dealing with us and answering our prayers, we are not going to be in Babylon; when the prayers get cast into the earth in Revelation 8, we are not in Babylon in that day. “and there will I plead with you face to face.” Because God is going to be with us; Christ is going to deal with us face to face.

The Lord will plead with us face to face; here is the precept, where he shows us his hands. “And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will seek to destroy all the nations that come against Jerusalem. And I will pour upon the house of David, and upon the inhabitants of Jerusalem, the spirit of grace and of supplications:” Grace is only for the house of David, the twelve tribes of Israel. You have these Christians running around talking about grace is for everybody; no, it is not, not according to the Bible.

“and they shall look upon me whom they have pierced,” That is the evidence: Christ is going to be in our midst, walking amongst us, the tallest of us all, the greatest of us all. “and they shall mourn for him, as one mourneth for his only son,” When we see him we are going to cry on that day, all of us, man, woman, boy, everybody, because the spirit is going to move us. “and shall be in bitterness for him, as one that is in bitterness for his firstborn.” As if your firstborn dies: if anyone's child dies, you know that feeling in you; some of us don't know what that is like, but some do. On this day all of us are going to feel like that when we see Christ and he shows us what was done to him. We are going to cry bitterly on that day.

Our prayers will be answered immediately, and the question is why. John gave us a key, a secret to having our prayers answered, and it begins here, but it is not going to be like on that day. “And whatsoever we ask, we receive of him,” Whatsoever we pray for, we receive of him. “because we keep his commandments,” That is the stipulation of God answering prayers. Christians, like some of your mothers, say God answers my prayers, I ain't going to keep a damn commandment. Satan answers prayers too (Matthew 4:8-9).

We want the Lord to answer our prayers immediately. When repenting, you start keeping the basic laws of God; the ones you can keep easiest are the outer laws, your hair, your beard, your clothing. The ones that take a little more time and effort are the internal laws, the moral laws, where you have to tune your spirit and obey: thou shalt not steal, thou shalt not commit adultery, thou shalt not bear false witness, thou shalt not covet. Covet is the sin that all the other sins begin with; even thou shalt not kill stems from covet. While we are in this truth we are still struggling to keep the commandments, trying to get it right, and we say the Lord is not answering my prayers, because we are not at the level where Christ was: he was walking perfect, keeping the commandments, and the Lord answered his prayers immediately. The apostles eventually got to that point; we are still struggling to get there.

“and do those things that are pleasing in his sight.” Not only keeping the commandments; we have to do those things that are pleasing in his sight. Like what? Go out and teach the word, spread the word. Some people say, oh, I keep the commandments, like the ones at home right now on Facebook just watching. You may be keeping the commandments at home, in your mama's house, but there is more to it than that: the older women teaching the younger women how to love their husbands, love their children; men going out spreading the gospel from city to city, state to state, country to country. It is more than just sitting in your room keeping the commandments.

You always hear Christians say God answers my prayers, I ain't keeping no commandment, so what are you Israelites talking about? Satan answers prayers too. “Again, the devil taketh him up into an exceeding high mountain, and sheweth him all the kingdoms of the world,” Satan the devil showed Christ all the kingdoms of the world, “and the glory of them;” The glory of them, meaning the riches, the wealth of all the nations. “And saith unto him, All these things will I give thee,” I'll give you rulership, power and wealth beyond imagination. “if thou wilt fall down and worship me.” If: just bow down and worship me. That is the stipulation. So Satan will do for you. People in Hollywood have bowed the knee to Satan; people in the entertainment world have bowed the knee to Satan; you watch on YouTube all the filthy things that go on behind closed doors, some of them doing rituals. That is what Matthew 4 is going into. That is your mama in the church that gets so-called blessings; that is your grandfather and grandmother: I got blessed by Jesus. What Jesus? That white man on the wall blessed me? Yeah, that is Satan, because you bowed the knee to Satan.

“And this is the confidence that we have in him, that, if we ask any thing according to his will,” If we ask anything according to his will. In order to know what his will is you must be studying the Bible: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart (Psalms 40:8). People say I do things according to his will; you don't even know what God's will is. “he heareth us:” Brothers say maybe it's not God's will that I get married. Are you kidding me? Doesn't the Bible say it is not good that man should be alone? It doesn't say it is good to have jelly and lotion.

To understand what God's will is. People say I do things according to his will; you don't even know what God's will is. “I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.” See that: that is his will. That is his will. So in 1 John 5:14, if we ask anything according to his will, he heareth us.

All this is stemming from Revelation 8:5, where Raphael cast the prayers of the saints into the earth and there were voices and thunderings and lightnings, which is evidence of when the Lord begins to answer our prayer in the midst of our speaking to him; this is taking us back to that time period and how we have to get to that point. “And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit,” So the Lord knows the mind of the Spirit. “because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.” That is what the Lord does: Christ makes intercession for us, the Holy Spirit, Christ, makes intercession for us, knowing what the will is.

What is a hindrance? This is how we can get our prayers answered, slowly but surely. “Ye ask,” Ye ask, meaning you prayed; when it says ask it is talking about prayer. “and receive not,” God is not answering your prayers. Why? “because ye ask amiss,” You ask for the wrong reasons; you are praying amiss, praying for the wrong reason. “that ye may consume it upon your lusts.” Like some of you cougars, or alley cats: you have women praying here, the sister is 40 or 50 and she wants the 20-year-old brother as a husband, and wants to know why God ain't answering my prayer. That is not his will, sister; that young boy wants children; you are past your prime. Leave the little boy alone, let him grow up and struggle with a girl his age. Here goes the older woman: go get the Icy Hot, put it on my back, my arthritis is kicking in. This young boy wants to do flips and somersaults in the bedroom. A sister came up to the table, said she was 46, her face said every bit of 56, and she wanted the 25-year-old brother that goes to the gym religiously, the one with the narrow waist and the wide shoulders. Did you look in the mirror, sister? She was a circle. I go to the gym; I don't know what you are doing in there. That is not his will, that you mess that boy's life up. In one of the schools a young brother married a wife way older, and it turned out he took out three life insurance policies on her; Tyler Perry has a movie about that, A Fall from Grace, a good movie: an older woman fell in love with a young strapping man and he used and abused the hell out of her. You want somebody to grow old together with; how are you growing old together if he is 20 and you are 40? When he is 40 she is 60. You have run past the finish line. When she hits menopause, that man is going to leave you. That is why we tell you all those marriages don't work, but you don't listen to us; you said to hell with the deacons and the bishop and did your own thing. We are just keeping it real, keeping it a hundred.

You are not following the will of God in your prayers; you are not balancing what you want according to God's word. That is why some of you brothers can't get married. One particular brother chases all these women: Bishop, show the sister my picture, I'm very handsome. We show it to the sister: oh hell no, don't do that to me, Bishop, don't ruin my life with that dude. Several times. Then a young lady pops up who likes him, and he says I don't like her, I don't want her. You are simple. Some people you can't help; let them rot. They chase something outside of their shoe size: if your size is eight, you wear eight. Like sisters back in the world who know they are a size 14 and buy a pair of pants that is a size 8, looking like the Michelin Man squeezed into them pants.

And you brothers with your jobs, praying God bless me with a job. God wants you to get a job, but some of you brothers are very talented, very smart, and your character is messed up. Talent will get you in the door, but your character will keep you in the room. Negroes don't understand that: you have the talent to get to the door, but you have to bring forth your character to make the interviewer like you: be on time, do what you are supposed to do on a daily basis, don't come with attitude, don't be lazy. You make excuses when people try to check you on your character, so we just leave you alone: he is going to fizzle out.

That ye may consume it upon your lusts, your pleasures: you are not praying for the right reasons. Some sisters pray for a particular house only because sister so-and-so has a house like that; she is in competition with this sister. I want a house better than her house, a pair of shoes better than her shoes, a head covering better than her head covering. Trying to keep up with the Joneses; people like that always go broke. That is why we made a uniform for the sisters: one sister came in with two-inch heels, the next week another with four-inch heels, then six, then eight; heel competitions. And a brother said he married a sister out of charity, he felt sorry for her; I think the charity went the other way. Be real with yourself: if you can't be real with me or the deacons, be real with yourself.

sense.text: “The first angel sounded, and there followed hail and fire mingled with blood, and they were cast upon the earth: and the third part of trees was burnt up, and all green grass was burnt up.” This is destruction coming; these sounding angels are going into destruction. Ezra shows the example: thy land, and thy mountains, all thy woods and thy fruitful trees shall they burn up with fire (2 Esdras 15:62). There is going to be a third part of trees burnt up here, and all green grass burnt up here; this is going into Babylon. And it goes with one of the plagues of Egypt: behold, to morrow about this time I will cause it to rain a very grievous hail (Exodus 9:18). The same plagues are repeating, only on a technological level.

“And the second angel sounded, and as it were a great mountain burning with fire was cast into the sea:” Highlight that part, a great mountain. This is all symbolic. Behold, I am against thee, O destroying mountain, saith the Lord, which destroyest all the earth: the destroying mountain, the great mountain, is Babylon the great, the United States of America, and the Lord will make it a burnt mountain, desolate for ever (Jeremiah 51:25-26). That is a prophecy about the United States of America. Zechariah prophesied of Zerubbabel in the last days: who art thou, O great mountain? before Zerubbabel thou shalt become a plain (Zechariah 4:6-7): the same mountain. Notice it gives different descriptions for America: one place calls it Babylon the great, another the great mountain, another O destroying mountain. John saw the outcome for this great mountain: Babylon the great is fallen, is fallen, the destruction of the United States of America (Revelation 18:1-11). This ain't treason talk, this is Bible talk: this is what the prophecies say and what is going to happen to this place. Isaiah saw the same destruction of Idumea, the Greco-Roman word for Edom, and this Edom is not ancient Edom but the good old USA, because who runs this country? Edom. I don't care if they put a black face in the White House; he ain't running nothing; Obama was not our savior (Isaiah 34:6-15). Come out of her, my people: where would God's people be? Not in Rome, over there you might find five black people. We have assimilated to the sins of America, wanting to be actors, singers, politicians, rappers, celebrating their holidays: they tell us to forget about slavery from 1619, it's old, yet Thanksgiving was established in 1620 and we celebrate that. Hypocrisy. Her plagues will come in one day, death, mourning, famine, and she shall be utterly burned with fire: you are talking about Australia on fire, you ain't seen no fire yet. It is the Lord judging her, not us; the media says everything that goes bad is the Black Hebrew Israelites now. And in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth (Revelation 18:24): a heavy verse. Christ said to the wicked Israelites, upon you may come all the righteous blood shed upon the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel; all these things shall come upon this generation (Matthew 23:34-39). That generation is long dead, so what did he mean? That generation is back. All them Israelites that rebelled against Christ and hated his guts are back here in Babylon, every last one of them; people who don't understand regeneration will be confused by that. And the great city where our dead bodies lie, Judah and Israel spiritually and mentally dead, is spiritually called Sodom, Egypt, and where also our Lord was crucified, Jerusalem (Revelation 11:8): this place is spiritually Jerusalem, because the same righteous Israelites are back, and the same wicked ones are back. They crucified not just his image but his teaching: when black women say it doesn't matter what he looks like, they are secretly saying he's white. His blood be on us, and on our children, said our forefathers (Matthew 27:25); that is why we got jacked up as a people, and our children will die here in America that follow the evil. The maids that pointed Peter out (Mark 14:65-70) are the same souls back today; in England the same kind of sisters sat amongst us, then ran to the court, pointed the brothers out and gave the layout of the school. “For they that say such things declare plainly that they seek a country.” Our people ain't seeking a country; only the prophets, us, are seeking a country, and America is not that country. “And truly, if they had been mindful of that country from whence they came out,” If our forefathers, especially the rebellious ones, had been mindful of where we came from, “they might have had opportunity to have returned.” They might have had an opportunity to return to the promised land. “But now they desire a better country,” We have read about the promised land, but now we desire a better one, “that is, an heavenly:” Because when the new kingdom is established, it tells you there are going to be twelve angels at twelve gates, and on the twelve gates the names of the twelve tribes of Israel, and the twelve foundations the names of the twelve apostles, and only the Israelites will enter into that kingdom; and there will be no temple, because the Lord will be the temple. The third part of the sun, moon and stars darkened, the day shone not for a third part of it, and the night likewise. “Immediately after the tribulation of those days” Because we are in tribulation. Well, do it again. Let's see you do it again. When people say I'm going to leave and do my own thing, it doesn't work like that; that is not how the spirit of God works. Why would you do that, when you could apply scriptures and fix your problem according to the scripture, instead of going inside and getting with Edom, going inside a man's house and taking his children's bed, his mattress, everything that belongs to that man, when even their own devil said that's enough? Then you say you are of God? No, brother, you are the ashy black devil. And these same people will sit there recording you, then go to brothers and sisters and get them to tell them their private business, and hold it against them: I know that sister will never go against me, because I have something on her. That is how they get their loyalty, like mafias, like Jodie Foster's character in Inside Man, who manipulated the mayor and the bank guy because she knew their secrets. The people gravitating to that evil person collecting information to form allies are not here for the word of God. These are called spots in your feasts of charity. You come in here, forget why you came for the truth, link up with somebody and tell them all your personal business, and now they have control over your life: you're a loser, you're not here for God; cursed be the man that trusteth in man and maketh his arm his flesh. You were a loser in the world and you're still a damn loser. But you can repent; don't let nobody have anything over your head; whatever you did in the world you did out of ignorance, so if they bring it out, repent and keep the commandments, and if you see them in their evil, flee from them.

These last couple of months certain things have been going on in the congregation, and some things we never used to make known to everybody, because we know the spirit of fear could jump on some of you brothers and sisters. But we let you know about the brother they wanted to coerce into planting something in the school, and about the shooting in Jersey the other day, and because you see these things happening and see how Esau is turning up the heat on Israelites, a lot of you have become fearful. That is the spirit that jumped on you. This is for you brothers and sisters that got scared because you see the attacks coming at IUIC, at Israel. “He that overcometh shall inherit all things; and I will be his God, and he shall be my son.”

“But the fearful, and unbelieving,” Understand that a fearful spirit and an unbelieving spirit go hand in hand. When you see Esau attacking the truth, the scripture says that is going to happen. You brothers and sisters in high places in this society, you have to know how to move, but don't be fearful and unbelieving: I ain't coming to the school no more, I ain't going to congregate with brothers and sisters no more, what if they take a picture of me by mistake, I'm not going to wear fringes no more, and now you don't even support the truth. That is a fearful and unbelieving spirit. You have to trust in the Most High; use wisdom and pull away from certain things, let us know, brothers, I'm in this position, try not to get pictures of me up there. We let you know the attacks and the plots coming against us not for you to become fearful and worried, but so that when it happens you are aware. If you are a police officer you have to wear a uniform on the job, you can't wear fringes there, but once you leave your job, in your leisure time you put on your fringes; that is what Esther did. Use wisdom, but if you are fearful, that is an unbelieving spirit: it is like you don't believe the Lord is going to look over you, that he is going to deliver you if anything happens to you. Everybody has a different level of faith; some brothers say I don't give a damn, they can fire me; but it is all about using wisdom. Woe be to fearful hearts, and faint hands, and the sinner that goeth two ways; woe unto him that is fainthearted, for he believeth not, therefore shall he not be defended (Ecclesiasticus 2:12-13). “and the abominable, and murderers, and whoremongers, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, shall have their part in the lake which burneth with fire and brimstone: which is the second death.”

precepts.why:
This deals with what Deacon Malachi just said about the fearful; in case you think he was talking off the top of his head, it is scripture. “Woe be to fearful hearts, and faint hands,” Woe meaning destruction be to fearful hearts and faint hands: you don't want to do the work. “and the sinner that goeth two ways!” Because you are double-minded; you go two ways, one foot in the world, one foot in Israel. Double-minded also goes into you traitors sitting amongst us learning and taking notes at last night's class while harbouring evil; your mind ain't here, it is somewhere else. The traitors that leave this truth will be on YouTube teaching what we taught them, as if the spirit came upon them and they learned it by osmosis.

“Woe unto him that is fainthearted!” The fainthearted is the fearful brother, the fearful sister. “for he believeth not;” Because you don't believe. “therefore shall he not be defended.” God says he won't defend a brother or sister like that. That is some heavy stuff right there. How would you show your belief? By your works; your works show you believe. They work together. If anything is able to move you, that means you have not believed what we preach, what God is trying to let us know: these little trials and tribulations we are going through are to purify us, just like gold, just like silver. This war is not going to be easy; God did not make it easy. You have to have faith in this, apply it, live it. Everything happens for a reason, and these scriptures are to guide us, build us up, uplift us, but a lot of times brothers and sisters don't believe; that is your unbelief.

sense.text: This solidifies the double-minded and the unbelieving. We are all waiting on Christ to come, but see what he says upon his return. “I know thy works, that thou art neither cold nor hot:” That is how some of you are here: you come in, shalom, Most High and Christ bless, and you're fake. You're not cold, you're not hot, you are just going through the motions; you have nothing better to do on Saturday so you show up here. “I would thou wert cold or hot.” I wish that you would pick a side instead of coming here week after week being fake, because if you are cold we can see it and find ways to build you up, and if you are hot, all praises to the Most High; but you stay right in the middle so nobody can tell what your true intentions are.

“So then because thou art lukewarm,” You're fake. “and neither cold nor hot,” You're an actor. “I will spue thee out of my mouth.” God ain't dealing with you, his Son ain't dealing with you, and you are going to die. When he says I will spue you out of my mouth, it means you will not be under the covering, you will not get the kingdom; he is not going to deal with you. That is for you. How many people call week after week and say this was great, good job, and they live fifteen, twenty minutes away and don't come, don't show up, but want to keep asking questions? You ain't wasting my time. As soon as I see your area code, oh, you live in so-and-so, the school is right there on the block: don't call here again. There are people in other countries trying to find a way to get a plane ticket to come here, and you are a train ride away, one hour away, with every excuse in the book. You are supposed to be here learning, fellowshipping, congregating and caring about this truth. You're lukewarm.

And people come through the door and form bonds with us and tell us personal information about themselves, some of them with things that are not right with them, and then you want to hook up with those people. It is not our job to divulge that personal information; before you marry them, get a blood test. Don't put us in the position of relationship police; those days are over, the world is coming to an end, we are at war. Follow the steps the Bishop has been saying since day one: make sure they have a job, their own place, that they are stable, watch their temperament, check their medical history, see their family. If you hit the back door, good luck with your diseases, good luck with your failed marriage, and don't blame IUIC. A sister with a sexually transmitted disease is told, you have to let the brother know before you talk to him; one brother said I don't care about that, I'll take it to a herbologist and heal it, and he did; that is what God has joined together. But the brothers who don't follow the protocol and sneak around our back and do the Humpty Dumpty, and now you have a disease: good for you, dance; both of you have to leave, the sister because she never told you, and you because you were stupid enough not to follow the instructions of your fathers. The Lord said the same to us: we didn't follow his instructions and got thrown overboard, fed to the sharks, castrated, raped, robbed and murdered, and he laughed at our calamity. Whatever happens to you is good for you, because you don't listen. A sister who was real loose here went to Texas and hooked up with some sucker, big wedding and everything, and they are not together now; if she couldn't get it right here, what makes you think she magically reappeared born again down there? She went down there like the demon she was; a lot of sisters like that came through these doors, couldn't get their minds right, and are walking disasters destroying other men's lives. Dance to your own tune.

A lot of you have the spirit of the Pharisees: you don't believe, and all they wanted was things for gain and positions that benefit only them. Watch what Christ had to tell them. “And when he was demanded of the Pharisees, when the kingdom of God should come,” You don't understand that what we are doing now is building the kingdom of God, and the Pharisees were in opposition to Christ establishing the kingdom of God. Some of you are just watching online to see when this kingdom is coming; you don't care about building it, about putting your brick in. If class doesn't go on, where they at? You don't care, you ain't doing nothing to make sure it happens from one week to the next, but you are right there demanding answers: break this down, break that down. “he answered them and said, The kingdom of God cometh not with observation:” That is what a lot of you people are doing: just observing. You don't want to do nothing, you don't want to help; the kingdom of God doesn't come by your observation. I don't care if you watch class; when you call and say I watch all your classes, well, what are you doing? Don't call here and waste my ears; we are at war.

“Neither shall they say, Lo here! or, lo there!” That is what you want to hear, only watching and observing; you don't care about being part of building the greatest movement known to mankind. “for, behold, the kingdom of God is within you.” What did he mean? The Most High put all of you on the line: you want the kingdom of God to come, you have to help. So many brothers get sick on these trips, and when a brother gets sick the mission stops; you are in another country worried, is this brother okay, doctors speaking different languages, and you don't know what they are doing to you. You know how much money it costs to rearrange flight plans, get hotels, get brothers to stay back with the sick brother? And you are just sitting there observing: let me see what them Israelites are doing now. You make me sick. If it was the white man doing this, Benny Hinn, you'd make sure he had enough gas in that jet; but the greatest movement known to mankind, all you want to do is observe. A lot of you are lying; you will just sit and watch online and do nothing to help build the kingdom of heaven that is within you. Christ prayed for more labourers; we never have enough labourers. People's lives, families, wives and children are being disrupted while you sit back observing, and you should be ashamed of yourself.

The Quest was good, and the islands we went to were all saying, who can you bring here to teach us? Many of the people want to learn. That is why we need you brothers to step up on your studies, so we can send men like we did in Sierra Leone, where we stayed a month, and that costs money; it is not for a yacht or a string of polo ponies, it is to put men in these locations, a month, six months, Lord's will a year, to teach our people who are saying blessed is he that comes in the name of the Lord, why are you leaving, stay and teach us. Brothers and sisters online not putting in any work: donate, show the Lord that you believe. In these countries our people are at need of everything; brothers there have to be taught even etiquette; brothers are about to lose their homes, don't have a roof. Christ paid taxes, he fed the people; have the same mindset as Christ. And you overweight brothers who want to go to camp: the walks were twenty minutes uphill in the heat, three miles, and fat-bodied brothers were passing out and brothers had to carry you back to the ship. You have to take care of your health or you are going to get sick and die; overeating is a sickness; control your diet. A brother or sister who cannot discipline their eating habits cannot discipline their spirit in the commandments of God; it takes discipline in everything. To do the work you have to be in shape. Captain Isaac and Deacon Malachi are going to do a training: burn the fat. If you look downstairs and don't see your friend, you're fat.
